Control Gap: Privileged accounts can sign in with a password alone.
Required Outcome: Every privileged human and break-glass account has MFA enrolled and enforced.
Remediation: Enroll the affected privileged accounts in MFA and enforce a policy that requires MFA for all privileged roles.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-MFA on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Users hold permissions they neither use nor have approval for.
Required Outcome: Assigned permissions match approved scope or observed use over 90 days.
Remediation: Remove the unused permissions the detector listed, then run a quarterly access review for privileged roles.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-EXCESS-PRIV on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Accounts of former staff remain enabled.
Required Outcome: No enabled human account is idle for more than 90 days.
Remediation: Disable the idle accounts, tie account removal to the leaver process, and auto-disable accounts after 90 days of inactivity.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-INACTIVE-ACCT on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: The local password policy is below baseline.
Required Outcome: Policy meets the length, complexity, expiry and lockout baseline.
Remediation: Set minimum length to 12 or more, require complexity, set a maximum age, and lock accounts after 10 failed attempts or fewer.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-PASSWORD on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Sensitive data stores are unencrypted or lack a customer-managed key.
Required Outcome: All sensitive stores use AES-256, tier 1 with customer-managed keys.
Remediation: Enable AES-256 encryption on the customer database and move tier 1 stores to customer-managed keys in the key management service.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-ENC-REST on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Sensitive flows use cleartext or outdated TLS.
Required Outcome: All sensitive flows use TLS 1.2 or higher with strong ciphers, or mTLS inside the network.
Remediation: Disable HTTP and TLS 1.0 and 1.1 on the affected endpoints, remove weak ciphers, and require partners to support TLS 1.2 or higher.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-ENC-TRANSIT on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Servers run software the vendor no longer supports or that carries severe vulnerabilities.
Required Outcome: No asset runs end-of-life software or unpatched CVEs rated 7.0 or higher.
Remediation: Migrate the affected servers to supported versions, patch severe CVEs, and keep an end-of-life register.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-VULN-SW on updated evidence and expect PASS

Required Outcome: Every in-scope endpoint has the agent installed, active and current.
Remediation: Reinstall the agent on the affected devices, force a definition update, and alert when a device falls out of compliance.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-ENDPOINT on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Required log sources are silent or have auditing off.
Required Outcome: All required sources are active, audited, reporting within 24 hours and ingesting normally.
Remediation: Restore the silent log forwarder, enable database auditing, and alert when a source stops reporting.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-LOGGING on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Storage holding sensitive data is publicly accessible.
Required Outcome: No storage holding sensitive data is publicly accessible.
Remediation: Turn on block-public-access for the affected buckets, remove public ACLs, and review access logs for earlier exposure.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-CLOUD-EXPOSURE on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Backups are missing, stale, or not protected from tampering.
Required Outcome: Every stateful asset has a recent successful backup, 30-day retention and, for tier 1, immutability.
Remediation: Create the missing backup policy, fix the failing job, and enable immutable storage for tier 1 backups.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-BACKUP on updated evidence and expect PASS

Control Gap: Administrative ports are open to the whole internet.
Required Outcome: No administrative port is exposed to 0.0.0.0/0 except through a controlled mechanism that requires MFA.
Remediation: Remove the direct rule and move remote administration behind zero trust access or a VPN with MFA.
Verification Method: Re-run DET-REMOTE-ACCESS on updated evidence and expect PASS
